Ambush: When making a Dexterity (Stealth) check or Initiative roll, expend a Superiority Die and add it to the roll unless Incapacitated.
Bait and Switch: Within 5 feet of a willing, non-incapacitated creature, expend a Superiority Die and switch places using at least 5 feet of movement. No Opportunity Attacks are provoked. Roll the die; you or the creature gains AC equal to the roll until start of your next turn.
Commander's Strike: When taking the Attack action, replace one attack to direct an ally. Expend a Superiority Die; a willing ally uses its Reaction to make a weapon or Unarmed Strike, adding the die to the damage.
Commanding Presence: When making a Charisma (Intimidation, Performance, or Persuasion) check, expend a Superiority Die and add it to the roll.
Disarming Attack: When you hit with an attack, expend a Superiority Die and add it to damage. Target makes a Strength save or drops an object it holds.
Distracting Strike: When you hit with an attack, expend a Superiority Die and add it to damage. Next attack against target by another attacker has Advantage before your next turn.
Evasive Footwork: As a Bonus Action, expend a Superiority Die to Disengage and add the die roll to your AC until start of next turn.
Feinting Attack: As a Bonus Action, expend a Superiority Die to feint a creature within 5 feet. You gain Advantage on your next attack that turn; on hit, add the die to damage.
Goading Attack: When you hit with an attack, expend a Superiority Die to add to damage. Target must make a Wisdom save or have Disadvantage on attacks against others until your next turn.
Lunging Attack: As a Bonus Action, expend a Superiority Die to Dash. If you move 5+ feet in a straight line before a melee attack this turn, add the die to its damage.
Maneuvering Attack: When you hit with an attack, expend a Superiority Die, add it to damage, and allow a willing ally to move half Speed without provoking an Opportunity Attack from the target.
Menacing Attack: When you hit with an attack, expend a Superiority Die, add it to damage, and force a Wisdom save or the target becomes Frightened until end of your next turn.
Parry: When a creature damages you with a melee attack, use a Reaction to expend a Superiority Die to reduce damage by the die roll + Strength/Dexterity modifier.
Precision Attack: When you miss with an attack, expend a Superiority Die and add the roll to the attack, possibly turning it into a hit.
Pushing Attack: When you hit with a weapon or Unarmed Strike, expend a Superiority Die, add to damage, and force a Strength save or push Large-or-smaller target up to 15 feet.
Rally: As a Bonus Action, expend a Superiority Die to give a visible ally within 30 feet Temporary Hit Points equal to the die roll + half your Fighter level.
Riposte: When a creature misses you with a melee attack, use a Reaction and expend a Superiority Die to make a melee attack against it; on hit, add the die to the damage.
Sweeping Attack: When you hit with a melee attack, expend a Superiority Die to potentially hit a second creature within 5 feet. If the original roll would hit the second creature, it takes damage equal to the die.
Tactical Assessment: When making an Intelligence (History or Investigation) check or a Wisdom (Insight) check, expend a Superiority Die and add it to the roll.
Trip Attack: When you hit with a weapon or Unarmed Strike, expend a Superiority Die, add it to damage, and force a Strength save or knock the Large-or-smaller target Prone.
